digest.component_or_area: reconciler core backend facade and jira adapter
propositions: A Backend facade with five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) and three opt-in capability Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental) must be defined to establish a named interface for multiple backends to implement
JiraBackend thin wrapper must delegate to existing Jira modules (AcliClient, outbound_fields, inbound_fields, jira_fields.py, comment_limits) with zero behavior change and no core rewiring
RemoteRef identity type (vendor, instance, remote_id) and IdentityConvention pure convention object must encapsulate the rebar-id label format currently inlined at four core call sites
Capability detection must use isinstance checks against @runtime_checkable Protocols, not a capabilities() method, with contract suite verifying capabilities are invoked only when implemented

Contract suite parameterized over both JiraBackend (injected mock transport) and FakeBackend must verify outbound-inbound round-trips, sanitizer idempotence, identity convention correctness, and capability guarding
Characterization tests must prove JiraBackend delegation is behavior-preserving by asserting pure Jira mapper outputs match pre-story main byte-for-byte on representative fixtures
